title: Backport SL Migration - Snapshot Project Transactions
summary: Support for snapshotting and migrating historical Dynamics SL project transactions is added to the SL historical data app, including new tables, viewing pages, and configuration options.
key_points: New tables store migrated SL project transaction data (PJTran, PJTranEx, PJProj, PJEmploy) in both source and historical formats
Pages added for viewing batch entries and project transaction details with project card and list extensions
Configuration field and migration logic introduced but not yet connected to wizard pages or orchestration
Permission sets updated to allow access to the new objects across all SL migration role sets
Backports functionality from NAV PR with follow-up wiring deferred
quote: Adds support for snapshotting/migrating historical Dynamics SL project transactions into the SL historical data app, with a new configuration toggle and viewing pages.
